Status: Wave 307 accepted (6.3): the free IFalconLogger getters

Method.evidence: Every free no-argument accessor returning Knx.Falcon.Logging.IFalconLogger takes the family name GetLogger: HawkNET Class492::b(), Class497::b(), Class498::d(), and Falcon Class1346::c(), Class1348::smethod_0(), Class1351::smethod_0(), Class1353::b(), Class1360::d(), Class1364::a(), Class1376::b(), Class1383::d(), Class1388::c(). The family already names this shape GetLogger (Class470, Class733, Class738, Class457`2 and Class474), each row is free and no class holds a second logger accessor. New helper perf-now/returning-free.py lists every free row whose signature returns a given named type, which is how the set was found; its query variant inside the wave builder needs the protection/map filter fixed (a static build was used here).
Method.themes: Whole-class families of accessors are nameable in one wave when the return type is readable and the convention is fixed by named siblings - the same move that named get_Stage (wave 306) and the property accessors (wave 284). Remaining: the Interface20/21/25/26 contracts (need their implementers named; the inventory has no Type rows), Class938 s d(ulong), the two result-code dispatchers, Class871 s four packed fields, and the call-chain-only blocks.
